cropMethod: Connected components at alpha > 8, minimum 500 pixels, expanded by 3 source pixels on each side. Crop metadata uses measured alpha bodies rather than nominal equal cells. Alpha under 8 contains faint connecting matte residue, so absolute nonzero-alpha bounding boxes are unsuitable. No pixel manipulation or background removal.

sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for original top-down RPG Ash & Aether. Create ONE landscape 2:1 PNG atlas with EXACTLY FOUR columns and TWO rows, EIGHT complete, separate props. Each prop is centered wholly within its own equal cell with at least 8% transparent empty padding on EVERY side. No part of any object crosses a cell edge, no overlap, no frames, labels, typography, or grid. The background must be actual alpha transparency, never a checkerboard/black/white backdrop. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target: match its detailed painterly craftsmanship, elevated 35-degree orthographic view, rounded organic forms, material depth, restrained upper-left light and gentle compact contact shadows. More natural subtle color; no glossy plastic, no pixel art, no photo. TOP ROW left to right: 1) twisted low mangrove root cluster with turquoise moss and a few rounded leaves; 2) limestone tidepool ledge, shallow pool and tiny coral as one compact object; 3) short old wooden fishing skiff drawn onto a small bank beside neatly coiled rope and draped fishing net, one compact connected grouping; 4) cattail clump with broad glossy water leaves at the base, realistic layered reeds. BOTTOM ROW left to right: 5) four worn broad river-stone stairs ascending toward rear, small weathered verdigris rail, moss in seams; 6) shell-pink fan coral outcrop with pale ivory branching coral and blue-gray rock base; 7) two woven reed fish traps with wicker texture on smooth river stones; 8) small gracefully bent riverside willow sapling on a compact low rock bank, drooping narrow leaves. These must look beautiful and convincing when drawn at 80–150 pixels tall in a playable game, with strong readable silhouettes. Exact order and complete isolated objects matter. No people, animals, text, numerals, flags, decorative sparkles or landscape background. Keep every tip, branch, rope, shadow and base inside the object's own cell. True RGBA transparency.
